text:
Priya (CSM): Heads up — TwoFold Marketing reached out about onboarding two new squads and a heavy embeddings job starting next week. Saw +3x qps last 24h. Anyone free to sync?

CapacityBot: Auto: Customer TwoFold has crossed usage threshold 'embeddings' (75%) and 'token' (60%). Opening capacity ticket INC-4021.

Liz (AE): Noted. Renewal for TwoFold is in ~6w — this looks like an upsell/opportunity. Do we have space to propose a Dedicated pilot? @Anson can you advise on integration effort?

Anson (SE): Should be straightforward. Two squads: 'Creative' will use generation/chat, 'Insights' will run batch embeddings nightly. Recommend reserved pods for embeddings and a quick prefix cache for chat. Need sample S3 path + expected batch size to size pods.

Priya (CSM): S3 path: s3://twofold-ml/runs/next-week. Expected ingest ~6,000,000 tokens/day, ~2 concurrent batch jobs. They also asked for improved p99 on chat (target < 500ms).

Tom (SRE): If they want p99 < 500ms for chat we should steer them to smaller-context models + prefix caching and aggressive batching on embeddings. I'll do a quick sizing calc.

Tom (SRE): ```
assume avg_tokens_per_request = 500
requests_per_day = 6_000_000 / 500 = 12_000
concurrent_workers = 2 (as reported)
qps_avg = 12000 / 86400 ≈ 0.14
peak_factor = 6 -> qps_peak ≈ 0.84
embedding_gpu_pods ≈ 1-2 depending on batching efficiency
```

Jules (Support): Can we schedule an onboarding workshop Wed AM? They want a 2hr runthrough + runbook. I'll draft an agenda and invite.

Priya (CSM): Please capture asks: enablement deck, sample prompts for 'Creative', eval prompt set for 'Insights' embeddings, monitoring hooks, and cost guardrails/alerts.

Liz (AE): :thumbsup: I'll propose a Dedicated pilot during renewal. Customer flagged cost predictability as a concern — can we offer a cost cap or committed tier?

Anson (SE): I'll prepare a prototype config with batching + quantization recs. Example config snippet: ```json
{
  "model": "open-llama-13b-q4",
  "quant": "q4_0",
  "batch_size": 64,
  "kv_cache": true,
  "autoscale": { "min": 1, "max": 4 }
}
```

CapacityBot: Ticket INC-4021 updated: assigned to eng-infra. Linked channel: #eng-infra.estimate.

Priya (CSM): Next steps: @Anson prototype config by Tue EOD; @Tom capacity estimate + pod recommendation by Tue EOD; @Jules schedule Wed AM workshop; I'll prep renewal convo + upsell deck and capture customer priority list.

Liz (AE): Marked. Looping in finance for pricing: @Marta (Finance) — Marta, any quick guidance on committed pricing for embeddings at ~6M tokens/day?

Marta (Finance): Quick note: committed tier discounts kick in at 5M tokens/day — this could materially reduce unit cost. Need term length to model exact numbers.

Priya (CSM): Thanks all. I'll update TwoFold and post the invite once Wed AM is confirmed. Ping here if you hit blockers.
